scope: Language-interface source directions only; no class-card promotion

selectedCards.name: Lingering Notes
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP: the selected ally must still be within 30 feet and hear the residual note at the named start; silence/incapacitation cancels it. No shared-language requirement and no translation substitution.

selectedCards.name: Fluid Tempo
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP: damage alone no longer resets rhythm; failed concentration, silence and incapacitation retain their explicit consequences. Comprehension does not sustain an inaudible performance.

selectedCards.name: Total Silence
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the actual failed-save verbal-casting/Reaction prohibition and its selected passive suppression. The title does not apply the whole Silenced condition or prohibit ordinary conversation.

selectedCards.name: Druidic
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP automatic Druidic knowledge and known-reader hidden-message access; nonknowers may spot the presence at the printed DC15, not decode it. NEW permanent-language convention gives ordinary Druidic speaking/reading/writing; a separate cipher or hidden layer remains separate. Comprehend Languages applies only to text within that spell's actual eligible literal scope.

selectedCards.name: Beast Spells
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the level18 Druid-spell V/S-in-form exception. It does not grant ordinary speech in every form, a language, inaccessible material components or immunity to an actual verbal-casting prohibition.

selectedCards.name: Archdruid
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the exact Druid-spell component exception at20, including the costly/consumed-material exclusions. No general language, voice, device-command or unrestricted other-class casting permission.

selectedCards.name: Bonus Cantrip
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the actual Druid cantrip/terrain grants. The language table's Storm-Druid description grants neither Primordial nor a communication spell.

selectedCards.name: Thunderhorn Stag
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the source attack/Deafened rider. Apply actual loss of hearing, not loss of language knowledge or automatic inability to speak.

selectedCards.name: Vermin Affinity
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the exact Tiny natural-beast/10-foot simple-feeling/direction interface. No control, complex testimony, writing or general animal-language fluency.

selectedCards.name: Arcane Stability
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP its damage-concentration scope. It neither resists silence nor makes all silence end otherwise legal nonauditory concentration.

selectedCards.name: Deathless Silence
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the actual attacks, saves, resource costs and suppression rider. No speech/hearing prohibition is added from the title.

selectedCards.name: Haunted
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP actual curse limitations. Narrative whispers create no new interpreter, teacher, language grant or authenticated speaker.

selectedCards.name: Haunted — Boon V
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the one actual familiar route, willing spirits actually encountered, limited observation and short message. No summoned source, omniscience, universal translation or imported Speak with Dead profile.

selectedCards.name: Tongues
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP -2 on applicable mortal social checks, Action/10-minute chorus suppression, restricted boons and the >1-hour mundane-concentration save/lost final10 minutes. Course bookkeeping is not a real interruption and does not evade this rule.

selectedCards.name: Tongues — Boon I
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP receptive spoken-mortal comprehension while unsuppressed, not speaking every language. Interpretation: up to3 hearing allies within25ft, +2 only to actually related Lore/Insight checks. NEW Lore label maps to the one actual relevant knowledge skill, not a new proficiency/currency. Fragmentary divine-script extent remains receipt-only.

selectedCards.name: Tongues — Boon II
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP speech-required activation, one hearing enemy15ft, WIS and hard-control guard. No unprinted shared-language eligibility; no general translation power follows.

selectedCards.name: Tongues — Boon III
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP speech-required Action, one creature15ft, 1/LR and NPC-save/player-agency rules. NEW local semantic bridge delivers only that yes/no question and permitted answer; it adds no hearing gate absent from this card, general fluency or compelled player confession.

selectedCards.name: Tongues — Boon IV
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP speech-required Action, one hour, beasts/ordinary plants/willing spirits actually addressable. Meaningful communication supplies its own bounded comprehension, not proficiency, control, new entities or hidden facts.

selectedCards.name: Tongues — Boon V
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP at most3 hearing creatures30ft, spoken command<=5 words, saves, hard-control guard and all prohibited commands. NEW bounded command meaning only; no additional shared-language test, permanent fluency or blanket control.

selectedCards.name: False Life — Boon II
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP conscious feigned-death restrictions, including no speech or Actions/Reactions. It does not make a living actor eligible for a corpse-interview effect.

selectedCards.name: False Life — Boon III
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP its exact either-move OR speak-normally OR Revelation choice. Speaking is not an extra free option in addition to one of the other two.

selectedCards.name: Shattered Mind
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the actual social disruption/save and player-agency boundary. No unknown language, protected-memory disclosure or forced new player intent.

selectedCards.name: Fate-Bound — Boon I
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the actual omen/declared challenge, hearing and changed-plan limits. Predictive wording is not automatic objective truth or universal recipient comprehension.

selectedCards.name: Echo Voice
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP willing allies within5tiles, passive telepathy separate from the Reaction/1RC reroll. NEW willing two-way directed conceptual messages need no shared spoken language; no mind-reading, sensory sharing, broadcast to other allies or hardware channel. Actual consent/range and timing apply.

selectedCards.name: Hush Descends
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP aura, costs, duration, hostile hard-control and Dread rules. NEW acoustic completion in LA-12: ordinary sound does not transmit in/through the aura. This affects everyone's hearing and any actually audible component, without applying the whole Silenced condition. Hostile explicit prohibitions remain; no thunder immunity or damage cancellation.

selectedCards.name: Dominion Smite
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP knowingly-false-statement restriction and refusal/evasion permission. Truth restriction does not grant listener comprehension, compel a statement or turn a sincere false belief into a known lie.

selectedCards.name: Aura of Authority
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP selected-aura and actual direct-spoken-lie/CHA procedures. No automatic translation, objective fact detection or proof of truth from a passed check.

selectedCards.name: Compelled Truth
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP direct knowing falsehood, actual saves and silence/refusal. Language knowledge does not establish the allegedly violated oath or compel confession.

selectedCards.name: Sovereign Mandate
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP exact selected targets, saves, concentration and refusal. No general semantic bridge or new speech beyond the actual effect.

selectedCards.name: Sovereign's Ascendance
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the Heaven's Decree cross-reference and its safe bounded choice; no forced belief, confession, free additional Action or generic domination. Use the actual called card, not a spell with a similar name.

selectedCards.name: Obey Aura
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP one simple prohibition, knowing violation and damage frequency. NEW explicit knowledge predicate: the target must actually comprehend/know the prohibition; merely uttering an unknown language does not establish knowing disobedience.

selectedCards.name: Silent Smite
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP no speaking since END of previous regular turn; intelligible speech, V components and deliberate vocal commands count, involuntary noise does not. Signs/mental messages are not vocal speech by themselves.

selectedCards.name: Aura of Stillness
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP conversation-volume boundary attenuation, concentration bonus and explicit permission for speech/V. It is not Silenced, Deafened, sound deletion or sonic-damage immunity.

selectedCards.name: Vow Unbroken
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP no speaking since BEGINNING of previous regular turn, then its own expiration/first-Smite and lost-on-speech rules. Do not normalize to Silent Smite's different window.

selectedCards.name: Hush
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP failed-save prohibition of speaking and verbal abilities through its exact window; mental/nonverbal operations remain possible if otherwise legal.

selectedCards.name: Quiet Step
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP quiet movement only. Talking is not muted and can have its actual detection consequences.

selectedCards.name: Wordless Ward
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP explicit no-verbal permission, including while Silenced. Actual resource, Reaction, range and remaining casting/component requirements still apply.

selectedCards.name: Still Mind
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP voluntary-silence duration/end predicates and exact concentration requirement. Signs and purely mental exchanges do not independently become speaking.

selectedCards.name: Silent Judgment
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP its distinct quiet-Smite/stealth and target speak/V denial windows. No whole-scene silence or general no-communication tag.

selectedCards.name: Vow Absolute
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP selected enemies' V-component prohibition with native start-save relief; ordinary speech is not categorically barred. The owner's own voluntary speech ends the Final as printed.

selectedCards.name: Death Touch — Silent Heretic
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the actual failed-save speak/V denial and duration. No unconsciousness or all-channel communication suppression.

selectedCards.name: Null Command Aura
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP V-only prohibition and start-turn CHA relief. The card expressly allows speech, nonverbal powers and ordinary weapon actions.

selectedCards.name: Null Command
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP damage/save and failed-save speaking/V denial through its own duration. It does not remove other Actions or create mind-reading.

selectedCards.name: Beast Empathy
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP natural beasts30ft that hear, simple emotions/directions, normal agency/Animal Handling. No fluency, compelled obedience or extra companion slot.

selectedCards.name: Balanced Elements
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP the express silence-exclusion. Its supported elemental extensions do not lengthen a silence effect.

selectedCards.name: Improved Concentration
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP Wizard damage-concentration advantage only. Actual auditory maintenance can still fail; ordinary nonauditory concentration is not ended just by a silence name.

selectedCards.name: Knowledge Transfer
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP Action,2RP,touch,willing ally,1hour,1/SR and no Expertise/memory/class/tool transfer. NEW language-mode cap: convey the donor's actual spoken competence and only the reading/writing/script modes the donor actually owns for that language, temporarily. Knowledge persists under ordinary current physical suppression but is not expanded by it.

selectedCards.name: Arcane Sanctuary
selectedCards.disposition: KEEP only communication independently allowed by its actual sanctuary rules; the title grants no telepathic network, through-wall speech or other-planar contact.

additionalActuallyReadCalledCard.disposition: KEEP hearing target30ft, exact cost/frequency, six legal instructions and follow/refuse choice. NEW only the bounded selected instruction is semantically conveyed to an eligible hearing target; no general language or belief change.
